provenance.notes: Synthetic four-input float16 Einsum contract fixture; the elementwise product depends on every bounded operand position.
A 4099-element reduction plane is not four-aligned; two batches must produce independent scalar results.

A 4097-element float16 reduction plane is not four-aligned; the odd length phase-shifts the alternating +/-1 pattern between the two batches, so dropping or double-counting an element flips a batch's sum sign.

A 33-column, 8192-row float32 reduction over the first axis (ij->j) alternates each row between 1.0 and a per-column ramp value from -1.0 to -0.5, giving every column a distinct sum; mixing values across columns would be observable in the result.

skipGpu.reason: Portable WGSL floating-point semantics do not guarantee preservation of the subnormal values required by this fixture. Backend evidence: WebGPU/Metal flushes f32 subnormal inputs to zero (WGSL permits subnormal flush-to-zero), so 1e-39*1e+38 underflows to 0 instead of the reference 1.8.

Portable WGSL floating-point semantics do not guarantee preservation of the subnormal values required by this fixture.
